items.prompt:

B) Salt
C) Protein
D) DNA

B) oxygen

D) salt

Photosynthesis captures
A) light energy
B) sound energy
C) no energy
D) magnetic energy

B) chemical

D) light

steps: The energy is stored as chemical energy in bonds.

A) chloroplasts
B) nucleus
C) bones
D) mouth

The raw materials of photosynthesis are
A) carbon dioxide and water
B) oxygen and glucose

steps: Carbon dioxide and water are combined using light.

items.prompt:
A plant in complete darkness cannot do photosynthesis because
A) there is no light energy to transform into chemical energy
B) it has too much water
C) it has no leaves
D) it is too warm
items.answer: A) there is no light energy to transform into chemical energy

steps: Without light, no energy is captured to make glucose.

items.prompt:
Photosynthesis transforms
A) light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose
B) chemical energy into light
C) sound into glucose
D) oxygen into light
items.answer: A) light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose

steps: Light energy becomes stored chemical energy.
